A: 79-year-old male clinically diagnosed as ATL with chest X-ray showing large pleural effusion; pleural effusion is clearly present and attributed to ATL but no allowed finding_key covers pleural effusion on radiograph, so panel excluded per findings-vocabulary rule. B: CT in 79-year-old HTLV-1 positive, pathologically confirmed ATL case shows captioned enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes, matching generalized lymphadenopathy on CT vocabulary; pleural effusion also visible but not in vocabulary so listed as proposed. C: PET shows high concentration in mediastinal mass in confirmed ATL case, but no allowed finding_key covers PET FDG-avidity / mediastinal mass; therefore excluded for lack of nameable vocabulary finding.
